deposit(uint256).details: PULL mode: strategy pre-approves, adapter pulls USDC once.      If all markets fail, revert rolls back safeTransferFrom atomically.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

isPushMode().details: Adapter calls transferFrom() to pull USDC from Strategy during deposit()

refreshFromRegistry().details: Only works if registry was set in constructor

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

unflagMarket(uint8).details: Manual unflag a market (after human review)

deposit(uint256).notice: Deposit with multi-market fallback. Tries active market first, then by APY desc.

externalMarketTVL().notice: Returns sum of totalAssets() across all enabled Morpho markets

initialize(address,address,address,uint2.notice: One-shot initialization called atomically by AdapterFactory.

investedAssets().notice: Returns invested assets from cached per-market NAV (O(n) reads from storage, no external calls)

investedAssetsLive().notice: Returns invested assets via live external calls (expensive, use for off-chain reads)

isPushMode().notice: Returns false because Morpho uses PULL deposit pattern

refreshFromRegistry().notice: Refresh markets from registry (clear and reload)

refreshNavCache().notice: Refresh cached NAV for all markets (callable by vault)
